meta.parties: Samaradiwakara Et Al v. De Sarah Et Al

rules.statement: The use of the word 'vesting' in a will does not necessarily indicate an intention to impose a condition on the request made by the testator, such as survivorship.
rules.supporting_quote: "Their Lordships are unable to concur in the view that the use by the testators of the word "vesting" indicates an intention to impose such a condition on the request made by them to their son Edwin."
